title: The wrong cost structure changes the result before the strategy does.
paragraph1: This is not only about active traders. An ETF accumulation plan can quietly stack TER, recurring order costs, and execution differences; a stock picker can choose the right name and still lose efficiency by using the wrong wrapper.
paragraph2: At the other extreme, intraday forex or index traders often focus on setup quality and underestimate spread, funding, and rollover. TradeScope starts from asset, strategy, and horizon, then calculates which broker and instrument combination actually makes sense.
quote: There is no universally best instrument. There is only the right combination for the right context.
card_note: TradeScope moves the discussion away from whatever is being sold and back to the real cost of the combination you are using.
row_1_pattern: TER, recurring orders, and fixed costs matter more than most people expect on long horizons.
row_2_pattern: If you use a derivative or unnecessary leverage, holding cost changes the expected edge.
row_3_pattern: Spread, slippage, and rollover eat edge long before the exit.
